lines.en: Hi Omar! Are you free this Friday?
Hi Sara! Yes, Friday is our family day. We visit my grandmother.
Nice! What time do you usually go?
We leave at ten in the morning and come back in the evening.
What is the weather like these days?
It is getting cold. Winter is coming.
Then wear something warm. Your brown coat looks nice!
Thanks! And your red dress is beautiful.
Thank you! How is your grandmother now?
She had a headache last week, but she feels much better now.
I am happy to hear that. Does she take medicine?
Yes, she takes medicine twice a day and sleeps well.
Good. Health is the most important thing.
You are right. Do you visit your family every week?
Yes, we visit my parents every Friday. My mother cooks very well.
What does she cook?
She makes the best molokhia in Egypt!
Haha, I love molokhia. Do you go by car?
Yes, my father drives. He works in a hospital, so Friday is his day off.
My father works in a school. He likes his job.
Do your brothers come with you?
Yes, my two brothers and my sister come. We have fun together.
That is a big family! Do you buy gifts for your grandmother?
Sometimes. Last week I bought her a green scarf.
Green is a beautiful color. She must love it.
She does. She wears it every day.
Listen, Omar, next Friday my family has a small party. Would you like to come?
Really? I would love to! What time?
At seven in the evening. We eat, drink tea, and talk.
That sounds great. Should I wear something special?
Just a nice shirt. Your blue one is great.
Okay, done. See you next Friday then!
See you! Say hello to your family.
I will. Goodbye, Sara!
